name: const unsafe fn split_at_unchecked (& self , mid : usize) -> (& [T] , & [T])
rule: The caller must ensure that `0 <= mid <= self.len()` when calling `split_at_unchecked`; an out-of-bounds `mid` causes undefined behavior even if the resulting reference is not used.
api: impl < T > [T] { const unsafe fn split_at_unchecked (& self , mid : usize) -> (& [T] , & [T]) }
